abstract: The vacuum lifting apparatus for flat workpieces (1), such as boards, planks, panels or the like of wood or wooden material, has a supporting frame (2) movable in the vertical and horizontal direction. A multiplicity of suction plates (3) are held on the supporting frame (2). The suction plates (3) are each connected to a vacuum distributor (6) via a line (4) with inserted control valve (5) for forming and releasing a vacuum and are connected from this vacuum distributor (6) to a vacuum reservoir (9) with vacuum pump (10) via a suction line (7) with inserted vacuum manipulating valve (8). A blast-air line (12) coming from a warm-air heater (11) and having an inserted control valve (13) is attached to the vacuum distributor (6), and this control valve (13) can here be controlled alternately with the vacuum manipulating valve (8) for shutting off blast air to the vacuum distributor (6) and for releasing blast air into the vacuum distributor (6). <IMAGE>
